description.narrative: The Green Trade Initiative (GTI) is meant to enhance the competitiveness of Egyptian horticulture products in the EU markets. GTI will adopt a value chain approach supporting the production and export to EU, through Italy, of 8 selected products, namely tomato, artichoke, pomegranate, strawberry, lettuce, green bean and pepper. GTI is covering production <(>&<)> quality control, logistics, access to finance and to markets, aiming mainly at small and medium producers and exporters.
